situation: My manager just asked me on Slack to build the competitor pricing dashboard by Friday. I already have the quarterly board report due Thursday and a client migration Wednesday. It's realistically 3 days of work.
reply: Happy to take the pricing dashboard, I think it'll be useful. Quick priority check though: I've got the Norland migration Wednesday and the board report Thursday, and the dashboard is about three days' work on its own. Options: I deliver a first version with the top five competitors Friday and the full one next Wednesday, or the board report moves to Monday and I focus on the dashboard. My recommendation is the first. Which do you prefer?
note: Align, name the constraint in days, show the trade-off, recommend, and ask them to choose.

situation: 老板在会上决定把我们产品的免费试用期从30天砍到7天，我觉得会严重影响转化，但会上没好意思说。想会后私聊他。
reply: 张总，关于试用期改成7天的决定，想在正式执行前提一个顾虑。我们的数据里，付费用户有将近一半是在第10到25天之间转化的，改成7天可能会直接砍掉这部分。如果这个已经考虑过了，我就全力配合推进。如果还没有，可以先拿一个渠道试行两周，看数据再全面推，您觉得呢？
note: 私下提，不当众；用数据说风险，给出一个低成本的替代方案，并留出'已考虑过就配合'的台阶。

situation: Pushed back on my boss about delivering the grant application and the donor newsletter both by Monday. She said 'I need both, figure it out.' I'm a program coordinator at a nonprofit.
reply: Understood, I'll make Monday the priority for both. To be clear, that means the newsletter goes out with three stories instead of five, and the volunteer training schedule moves to Wednesday. I'll send the grant application for your review by 2pm Monday.
note: When they insist, don't argue a second time. Say what slips, in writing, and deliver what you said.

situation: My boss Alan just texted asking me to finish the investor memo over the weekend. Saturday is my sister's wedding and I'm a bridesmaid. It's about a day of work.
reply: Hi Alan, I can't work on it this weekend, it's my sister's wedding on Saturday and I'm in the wedding party. I can start first thing Monday and have the memo to you by noon. If it truly can't wait, I can send you my outline and the latest numbers tonight so you can pick it up. Which would you prefer?
note: A clear no to the weekend, then what it would take and a choice for him. No long apology for having a life.

situation: My boss Rachel wants me to tell our client Brightline on Thursday's status call that the app launch is on track for Oct 20. QA has 14 blocking bugs open and my honest estimate is Nov 3.
reply: Rachel, I want Thursday's call with Brightline to go well and keep their trust. Right now QA has 14 blocking bugs open, and my honest estimate for launch is November 3, not October 20. If we say on track and then slip, it will cost us more with them than two weeks will. Two options: tell them Thursday about the new date with the fix plan, or launch the core flows on the 20th and ship payments on the 3rd. I'd go with the second. Could you decide by tomorrow so I can prepare the deck?
note: Pushing back on being asked to mislead a client: frame it around the relationship both of you want to protect, and give options that are all honest.

situation: 我是公司的数据分析师，三个月来老板一直让我顺手帮他订差旅、整理报销，现在每周要花五六个小时，数据报表经常拖到周末做。想跟他提一下。
reply: 刘总，想跟您对一下我这边的工作安排。这三个月我一直在帮您订差旅、整理报销，偶尔急用我很乐意帮忙，但现在每周要占五六个小时，周报和月度经营分析经常只能挪到周末赶。想请您定一下：要么正式把这部分算进我的工作，相应调整报表的优先级；要么交回行政部。我更倾向于交回行政，这样月报能保证每月5号出。您看哪种合适？
note: 说清占用的时间和因此被挤掉的核心工作，给两个选项和自己的倾向，让老板来做选择。

situation: For six weeks my manager Priya has added 'urgent' requests every Monday, and every week I've had to triage and push other things back. I'm working most evenings. We have a 1:1 on Thursday and I want to send her the topic ahead so it's not a surprise.
reply: Hi Priya, for our 1:1 on Thursday I'd like to talk about my overall load rather than any single task. For the last six weeks we've re-prioritised every Monday, and I've been finishing most weeks in the evenings, which isn't sustainable and puts quality at risk. I'll bring a list of everything on my plate with rough hours, plus two options: moving the vendor reporting to Tom, or a fixed Monday slot where new requests get ranked against what's already there. Could we use the time to pick one to try?
note: When pushback happens every week, raise it once as a capacity problem, with data and options, and let her choose.

situation: 今日の午後、佐藤課長と口頭で話して、新規顧客向けの提案書を10月9日（金）に初版、10月16日（金）に完成版で出す代わりに、9月分の月次レポートの締め切りを10月14日（水）に後ろ倒しすることになった。あとで食い違わないようにメールで残したい。
reply:
佐藤課長
お疲れさまです。本日の打ち合わせで決まった内容を、確認のためお送りします。
・新規顧客向け提案書：10月9日（金）に初版、10月16日（金）に完成版を提出
・9月分の月次レポート：締め切りを10月14日（水）に変更
認識に違いがあれば、お手数ですがご指摘ください。
田中
note: 口頭で決めた優先順位は、その日のうちに確認の形で文字に残す。何かずれた時に自分を守るのはこの記録。

situation: 同组的小美10月12日开始休四个月产假，经理陈总让我把她负责的6个客户都接过来。我手上已经有8个客户，全接的话每家的月度复盘肯定做不过来。
reply: 陈总，小美的客户我愿意接，也想保证她休假期间客户这边不掉链子。现在我手上有8个客户，每家的月度复盘大概要一天，再加6家就是14家，我一个人做不到每家都按时复盘。两个方案：一是我接她最大的3家，另外3家给阿杰；二是6家都我接，这四个月的复盘从每月一次改成两个月一次。我建议第一个，大客户不受影响，阿杰那边也有余量。您看选哪个？定了我就排时间跟小美交接。
note: 不是拒绝接活，而是把工作量算清楚，给两个方案和自己的建议，让领导来选。

situation: My manager Derek in New York just announced our daily standup moves to 9am Eastern from Monday Oct 5. That's 6am for June and Rafael on our team in Seattle. They mentioned it to me and I said I'd raise it. I'd rather message Derek privately than push back in the team channel.
reply: Derek, can I flag one thing about the 9am standup before it starts Monday? I like getting everyone together earlier in the day, but 9 Eastern is 6am in Seattle for June and Rafael, every day, and they've both said it'll be tough. If there's a reason it has to be 9, I'll get behind it. If not, two options: 11:30 Eastern, which is 8:30 for them and still before lunch here, or 9am live with Seattle posting updates async. My vote is 11:30. Which would you prefer?
note: Disagreeing with a decision: privately, before it takes effect, the cost in plain facts, room for a reason you don't know, and options with a recommendation.

situation: 国庆10月1日到8日我请的假早就批了，机票也订了回成都。今天周二下午王总突然说系统10月5日上线，让我假期每天在线盯着。我是后端，上线主要涉及我负责的支付模块。
reply: 王总，上线很重要，我也希望5号稳稳上线。现在的情况是我1号到8号的假已经批了，机票也订了。我想了两个办法：一是明天下班前把支付模块的上线手册和回滚方案写好，跟小李过一遍，5号由他值守，上线当天上午10点到12点我远程在线；二是如果必须由我全程盯，上线改到9月30日或10月9日。我建议第一个，您看哪个合适？
note: 先认同目标，再把冲突和两个选项摆出来并给出建议，让老板来选；定下来后发一条文字确认。

situation: I work at a small café. My manager Sam wants me to close alone from Monday Oct 5, including cashing up and walking the takings to the bank's night safe at 10pm. Two people always closed before. We do have a locked safe in the office.
reply: Hi Sam, happy to take on the closes, I know the rota is tight. The one part I'm not comfortable with is walking the takings to the night safe alone at 10pm. Two options: keep a second person on until 10:15 for the bank run, or lock the takings in the office safe and whoever opens banks them in the morning. I'd suggest the second, since it costs nothing. Which would you prefer?
note: On a safety concern, say yes to the job and no to the specific risky part, with cheap fixes; if it's refused, check the staff handbook on lone working.

situation: Mein Chef, Herr Becker, hat das Budget für unsere Kundenkonferenz am 19. November von 40.000 auf 28.000 Euro gekürzt. Er erwartet aber weiterhin 200 Gäste und ein gesetztes Abendessen. Laut den aktuellen Angeboten kostet das rund 39.000 Euro.
reply: Herr Becker, ich möchte, dass die Kundenkonferenz am 19. November auch mit dem kleineren Budget ein Erfolg wird. Mit 28.000 Euro reicht es laut den aktuellen Angeboten aber nicht für beides: 200 Gäste und das gesetzte Abendessen kommen auf rund 39.000 Euro. Zwei Möglichkeiten: Wir bleiben bei 200 Gästen und ersetzen das Abendessen durch ein Flying Buffet, das spart etwa 12.000 Euro, oder wir behalten das Abendessen und laden 140 Gäste ein. Ich empfehle das Buffet, weil der Vertrieb die Gästeliste schon hat. Können Sie mir bis Freitag sagen, welche Variante wir nehmen?
note: Budget cut, same scope: put the numbers side by side, give two options that fit the new budget, recommend one and let him choose.
